newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara 91-day bills average yield 6.767 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara 91-day bills average yield 6.767 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank said it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.767 percent at its auction of 91-day Bank Negara bills for 500 million ringgit.
At its previous auction on October 22 for a similar amount, Bank Negara accepted bids at an average yield of 6.687 percent.
The bids were in a high/low range of 6.775/750 percent against 6.700/645 percent two weeks ago.
Payment for the issue is on Wednesday.
Dealers said the central bank was rolling over a maturing Bank Negara bill issue of the same size.
